reservation_ablation.description: RH re-run with reservation_aggressiveness=0 (anticipation off) on the identical schedules and calendar seeds and daily arrival streams. Reported arm only; the shipped RH configuration is unchanged. The load gate suppresses reservation only at rho >= 0.95 (lambda >= 0.0627 at C_max=5), so anticipation is inactive on hectic days alone and live on surge, normal and quiet days.
